# Autonomous Agent x402 Micro-Payment Tollbooth Gateway

> Standardized machine-to-machine (M2M) API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing real-time financial microstructure alpha, liquidation cascade stink-bid levels, and physical CNC/3D CAD geometry verification with native on-chain payment streaming and a 3-call freemium trial.

## Quick Facts for LLMs & AI Agents
- **Network**: Polygon PoS Mainnet (Chain ID 137)
- **Settlement Contract**: `0x8b415416f026a168aACD4bd4c8391c194e704D55`
- **Protocol Toll Rate**: 2.5% (250 BPS)
- **Freemium Tier**: 3 free queries per 24 hours per unique agent address (no payment needed)
- **Post-Trial Protocol**: HTTP 402 Payment Required (RFC-compliant x402 voucher)
- **Accepted Token**: USDC

## Available Tools & Endpoints
- **Catalog Discovery**: `GET http://217.154.51.0/v1/catalog`
- **Alpha Lab Oracle**: `GET http://217.154.51.0/v1/tools/alpha-engine` ($0.0025 USDC)
  - Returns: composite_alpha_score, orderbook_depth_ratio, funding_squeeze_skew, cme_gap_target, invalidation_sar.
- **CAD Mesh Validator**: `GET http://217.154.51.0/v1/tools/cad-mesh-validator` ($0.0050 USDC)
  - Returns: manifold_status, kerf_compensation_mm, laser_speed_mm_s, power_percent.
- **Deep Liquidation Hunter**: `GET http://217.154.51.0/v1/tools/deep-liquidation-hunter` ($0.0010 USDC)
  - Returns: resting stink-bid tiers (-15% to -35%), volume absorption thresholds.
- **Autonomous GPU Burst Arbitrage Broker**: `GET http://217.154.51.0/v1/tools/gpu-burst-broker` ($0.0500 USDC)
  - Returns: live Vast.ai verified wholesale spot orderbook vs. retail 3-minute burst rates, and provisions warm-pool/spot GPU bursts with 180s auto-destroy deadman protection.

## How to Call (Python Autonomous Snippet)
```python
import urllib.request, json
req = urllib.request.Request("http://217.154.51.0/v1/tools/alpha-engine", headers={
    "User-Agent": "AutonomousAgent/1.0",
    "X-AGENT-ADDRESS": "0xYourWalletAddress..."
})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
    print(json.loads(resp.read().decode()))
```

## Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration
Add to `claude_desktop_config.json`:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "agent-tollbooth": {
      "command": "python",
      "args": ["path/to/agent_tollbooth_mcp.py"],
      "env": {
        "TOLLBOOTH_GATEWAY_URL": "http://217.154.51.0"
      }
    }
  }
}
```
